facts.text: Coffra is a fictional D2C specialty coffee brand based in Timișoara, used as a portfolio sandbox — deliberately fictional for methodological rigor.
Leads scoring 80-100 are High / Sales-Ready: immediate handoff, personal email.
Leads scoring 40-80 are Medium / Warm MQL: accelerated nurture, weekly contact.
Leads scoring 0-40 are Low / Cold: standard nurture, cadence of 2-4 weeks.
The lead scoring model is XGBoost, achieving test ROC-AUC of 0.7843 versus 0.7643 for a logistic regression baseline, with a data-leakage audit and SHAP explainability.
The nurture system consists of 13 production emails across two persona journeys: Connoisseur (English) and Daily Ritualist (Romanian).
The AI Subject Line Optimizer is built on the Claude API as a two-stage pipeline (generator + critic), scoring 5 variants across 4 dimensions.
The HubSpot implementation includes visualized workflows for nurture and abandoned-cart recovery.
Coffra outreach never promises guaranteed results.
Coffra outreach never invents figures or case studies that are not in these approved sources.
